preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, both x and y must be integers between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 0' if x != y else True
postconditions.description: If x cannot be transformed to y, output '0 0'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == f'{a} {b}' if x == y else True
postconditions.description: If x can be transformed to y, output any valid pair of positive integers a and b.
